subject: Re: [VOTE] Airflow Providers, release preparation date 2026-10-06

messages.subject: Re: [VOTE] Airflow Providers, release preparation date 2026-10-06
messages.body:
+1 (non-binding)
Have tested my parts #73522 (via influxdb: 2.13.0rc1) and #73725 (via elasticsearch: 6.9.2rc1 and opensearch: 1.14.0rc1)
and they work as expected.
Thanks, Jarek.

On 2026-10-08 14:40 UTC Jarek Potiuk wrote:
> Hey all,
>
> I have just cut the new wave of Airflow Providers packages with release
> preparation date 2026-10-06. This email is calling a vote on the release,
> which will last for 72 hours and will end on 2026-10-11 14:47 UTC.
>
> Consider this my (binding) +1.
>
> The completeness check found all expected artifacts. All 217 staged
> artifacts passed signature and SHA-512 verification against the published
> Airflow KEYS file. Apache RAT reported 0 unapproved and 0 unknown files.
> A rebuild from the release tag reproduced all 217 artifacts byte-for-byte.
>
> The PMC installation smoke test reported that Airflow 3.4 skips
> apache-airflow-providers-common-ai 0.11.0rc1 because Airflow requires
> apache-airflow-providers-common-ai>=1.0.0. We plan to release common.ai
> 1.0.0rc before releasing Airflow 3.4.0rc.
>
> Please take this known compatibility gap into account when voting.
>
> Airflow Providers are available at:
> https://dist.apache.org/repos/dist/dev/airflow/providers/2026-10-06/
> (SVN revision: r88287)
>
> Release tag:
> https://github.com/apache/airflow/tree/providers/2026-10-06
>
> The provider testing status issue is:
> https://github.com/apache/airflow/issues/74459
>
> The test procedure for PMC members is described in:
> https://github.com/apache/airflow/blob/main/dev/README_RELEASE_PROVIDERS.md#verify-the-release-candidate-by-pmc-members
>
> The test procedure for contributors is described in:
> https://github.com/apache/airflow/blob/main/dev/README_RELEASE_PROVIDERS.md#verify-the-release-candidate-by-contributors
>
> Public keys are available at:
> https://dist.apache.org/repos/dist/release/airflow/KEYS
>
> Please vote accordingly:
>
> [ ] +1 approve
> [ ] +0 no opinion
> [ ] -1 disapprove with the reason
>
> Only votes from PMC members are binding, but members of the community are
> encouraged to test the release and vote with "(non-binding)".
>
> Please note that the version number excludes the 'rcX' string. This will
> allow us to rename the artifact without modifying the artifact checksums
> when we actually release it.
>
> The issue is also the easiest way to see important PRs included in the RC
> candidates. Detailed changelog for the providers will be published in the
> documentation after the RC candidates are released.
>
